ns2:course.label: Regional Studies in Musicology
ns2:course.description: Seminar devoted to intensive study in the music of specific peoples, states, or geographic regions from around the world. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Undergraduates may repeat to a maximum of 12 hours; graduates may repeat to a maximum of 16 hours. Prerequisite: MUS 313 and MUS 314; junior standing; or consent of instructor.
